You will architect, validate, and execute high-availability desktop solutions centered on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) hybrid and public cloud bare-metal infrastructure.

The position is fully remote within the EMEA region, offering high flexibility, but requires the ability to travel up to 25% including dedicated time doing customer discovery, architectural workshops, executive briefings, and partner collaboration across EMEA.

Cloud Desktop Architecture: Design scalable, high-availability virtual desktop solutions (AVD and hybrid desktop pools) bridging on-premises data centers and public cloud bare-metal environments (Azure & AWS).
